info.title: ElcareHub Indexer API
info.description: Off-chain event indexer and REST API for the ElcareHub NFT marketplace on Stellar Soroban. All BigInt values (IDs, endTime) are serialised as decimal strings.

owner.description: Current owner address, null before first sale

price.description: RAW on-chain price in the token's base units (i128, unscaled — e.g. stroops for a 7-decimal token). The contract never scales this value; see `priceDecimal` for the human-readable form.

priceDecimal.description: Human-readable price, computed as price / 10^decimals using the payment token's known decimal precision (see docs/guides/payment-tokens.md). Safe to display directly.

nftTokenId.description: NFT token ID within the collection

createdAtLedger.description: Ledger sequence when the listing was created

updatedAtLedger.description: Ledger sequence of the last state change

reservePrice.description: RAW minimum acceptable bid in the token's base units (unscaled i128). See `reservePriceDecimal` for the human-readable form.

highestBid.description: RAW current highest bid in the token's base units (unscaled i128). See `highestBidDecimal` for the human-readable form.

highestBidder.description: Address of the current highest bidder

endTime.description: Auction end time as Unix timestamp string

amount.description: RAW offered amount in the token's base units (unscaled i128). See `amountDecimal` for the human-readable form.

expiresAt.description: Ledger timestamp after which the offer can be reclaimed; absent when it never expires

eventType.description: Contract event type (e.g. LISTING_CREATED, ARTWORK_SOLD, BID_PLACED)

actor.description: Primary address that triggered the event

data.description: Raw decoded event payload (varies by eventType)

kind.description: Collection type: normal_721 | normal_1155 | lazy_721 | lazy_1155

totalEarned.description: Total royalty earnings as a decimal string (7 dp)

payoutCount.description: Number of secondary sales that generated royalties

lastPayout.description: Unix timestamp (ms) of the most recent royalty payout, 0 if none

listingId.description: Listing id for fixed-price / offer settlements, null for auctions

auctionId.description: Auction id for auction settlements, null otherwise

salePrice.description: Total sale price of the settlement

totalVolume.description: Cumulative sold volume in raw base units (decimal string)

floorPrice.description: Lowest active listing price in raw base units; null when no active listing

recentActivity.description: Latest events involving this collection's listings

totalVolume.description: Cumulative sold volume as a decimal string

activeUsers.description: Distinct actors in the requested time window

timeRange.description: Echoed back when a time filter was applied

range.description: Time window used ("all" when no range param was given)

salesTimeline.description: Daily sales counts for the time window

anyOf.description: Human-readable reason returned by the rate-limit middleware.
anyOf.example: Too many requests, please slow down.

anyOf.description: Standard error envelope used by abuse detection.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the exceeded window.

windowMs.description: Length of the exceeded rate-limit window in milliseconds.

RateLimitPolicy.description: Rate-limit policy of the budget that was applied to this request, formatted as `<limit>;w=<windowSeconds>`.

RateLimitLimit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the current rate-limit window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Number of requests still allowed in the current rate-limit window.

RateLimitReset.description: Number of seconds until the current rate-limit window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Number of seconds the client should wait before retrying the request (RFC 9110 `delay-seconds`).
